$description: The light context: colour roles on the natural-white page.

color.$description: Semantic colour roles. Each is a light value with its dark twin in $extensions (emitted as light-dark()), so a subtree can switch mode with color-scheme alone.

bg-raised.$description: Cards, the dropdown list, controls' fill

bg-hover.$description: The wash under a hovered quiet button or option

text-muted.$description: Captions, meta, hints (4.5:1 on every surface)

rule.$description: Hairline rules and dividers (decorative: no contrast floor)

accent.$description: The spot ink: links, primary buttons, checked controls

on-accent.$description: Text and marks on the accent

accent-soft.$description: The selected option, a pressed chip

highlight.$description: Marigold: the quote rule and mark, list bullets, the dinkus, the progress highlight, the lightbox's current frame

highlight-ink.$description: Marigold as type: big numerals and the like, dark enough to read (4.5:1 on paper)

focus.$description: The focus ring (3:1 on every surface)

scrim.$description: Behind a modal: the lightbox's smoke

on-image.$description: Text laid on a photograph, over image-shade

image-shade.$description: The shade under text on a photograph

shadow-strong.$description: Shadow tint for dialogs and the dropdown list
